source_note: Manual correction from DTlgrind inventory screenshots and user correction. Public web search on 2026-07-08 did not return reliable indexable sources for these exact item names, so treat as user-verified/manual knowledge until confirmed by a better source pack.

items.name: Core Choice Chest
items.gives: 1 selectable equipment/core material: Eternal Core, Void Core, or Chaos Core
items.not_for: Does not choose a tech skill such as Lightning, Laser, Soccer, Drone, or Rocket.
items.optimizer_rule: For DTlgrind, choose the core type needed by the next SS forge step; if no forge screen requirement is visible, default recommendation is Void Core because Eternal=20 and Chaos=10 were already listed while Void stock was not listed.

items.name: Tech Core Choice Chest
items.gives: 1 selectable tech-core type material, not a direct tech-part upgrade and not a Lightning/Soccer/Laser choice by itself. If the selection screen offers Eternal/Void/Chaos tech cores, pick the type required by the tech/SS/Twinborn requirement being completed.
items.not_for: Do not map this item to Soccer Mode, Lightning Mode, Laser Mode, etc. without a separate cost table showing that those modes require that exact core type.
items.optimizer_rule: Keep as core selector value. Spend only when the target screen asks for a specific Eternal/Void/Chaos tech core type; for DTlgrind, prefer Void-type if the choice is unrestricted and Void stock is the bottleneck.

items.name: Relic Core Chest
items.gives: Relic core / relic-core selector used for SS gear progression.
items.optimizer_rule: Use only for SS gear breakpoint material. Do not spend if the SS upgrade cannot be completed immediately.

items.name: S Grade Excellent Equipment Choice Pack
items.gives: Selectable S-grade excellent equipment item, used as gear/fodder/value storage.
items.optimizer_rule: Save unless it directly completes a chosen SS forge/core/fodder requirement.

items.name: Voidwalker Excellent Equipment Supply Crate
items.screen_icon_hint: purple S crate with red/pink center badge
items.optimizer_rule: Save unless Voidwalker gear/fodder is the exact missing piece for a completed upgrade.

items.name: Awakening Crystal
items.optimizer_rule: Spend only if it completes the next Nutjob/Xeno awakening star or stat breakpoint now; otherwise save.
